sloka: दैवतानि च यान्ति अस्मिन् वने विविध पादपे ।नमस्करोमि अहम् तेभ्यो भर्तुः शंसत माम् हृताम् ॥३-४९-३२॥
transliteration: daivatāni ca yānti asmin vane vividha pādape ।namaskaromi aham tebhyo bhartuḥ śaṁsata mām hṛtām ॥3-49-32॥

translations.english: O river Godavari abounding in swans and cranes, my salutations to you Tell Rama immediately that Ravana is taking away Sita.
